headline: Enforcers cash a 56-point apology tour
dek: End Zone Enforcers drop 130.3 on Hail Mary Heroes, who spent 158 last week and apparently left the receipt in the car.
body: Week 14 in Strictly Jayers Football was two different sports. End Zone Enforcers 130.3, Hail Mary Heroes 73.7 — a margin that should come with a courtesy text. Across the hall, Turf Titans 127.9 finally remembered Gridiron Goons exist and won 127.9–103.2.
Heroes had just put up 158 in week 13. This is the league's favorite genre: one week you are a problem, the next week you are a cautionary tale with a kicker.
The all-play board still has opinions about who is actually good. Read them below, then lie about them in Discord.

ranking_copy.blurb: Hail Mary Heroes: 8-6 and 1,737 PF, which is a lot of points to still be capable of a 73-burger. Ceiling remains illegal.
End Zone Enforcers: also 8-6, but they spent week 14 looking like the team the standings have been hinting at. Highest score, biggest blowout, no notes.
Turf Titans: 7-7 after handling the Goons. Mid-table with a pulse. Do not draft their vibes in the group chat.
Gridiron Goons: 5-9, 103.2, and still in the league, which is the participation trophy we do not give out.
